ValidationRule.description: ASU Coach Outreach The field Drop Reasons or Not Registered is required to close this case on Case Sub Type Not Registered, The Final Countdown, Dropped/Withdrawn Course
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordTypeId = "012d00000021xGL", $User.ProfileId <> "00ed00000017Iob" , LEFT( TEXT( Status ),6) = "Closed", TEXT( Status ) <> "Closed: Admin", TEXT( Status ) <> "Closed: Automated - No Activity", TEXT( Status ) <> "Closed: No Contact Necessary", ISBLANK( TEXT( Drop_Reasons__c )), ISBLANK( TEXT( Not_Registered__c )), OR( TEXT( Sub_Type__c ) = "Not Registered", TEXT( Sub_Type__c ) = "The Final Countdown", TEXT( Sub_Type__c ) = "Dropped/Withdrawn Courses - First Session", TEXT( Sub_Type__c ) = "Dropped/Withdrawn - All Courses", TEXT( Sub_Type__c ) = "Dropped/Withdrawn Course") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Drop Reasons or Not Registered is required for this Sub Type
